search_text: published ZDI-26-447 ZDI-CAN-29251 Heimdall Data Database Proxy generateFileContent CRLF Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2026-07-23 CVE-2026-12357 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-12357 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Heimdall Data'] ['Database Proxy'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Heimdall Data Database Proxy. title: Heimdall Data Database Proxy generateFileContent CRLF Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Heimdall Data Database Proxy. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the generateFileContent function. The issue results from the lack of proper neutralization of CRLF sequences. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
